answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake in shared escrow, like marble counters held in a common vault: spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back with interest. Reputation then grows slowly, like an orchard tended season after season, so a brand-new identity cannot buy instant trust. A velvet-smooth free onboarding invites exactly the flood of sock puppets the stake is meant to price out.
